name: chat-composer
title: Chat Composer
summary: A chat panel with conversation tabs, a thread of messages and a composer.
description: A compact chat panel with conversation tabs, a thread and a composer. A pill tab strip switches between conversations (our tabs; panels swap instantly), the thread is made of Message components (the user's prompts as bubbles, the agent's steps as labelled messages), and a composer at the bottom sends. Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line, nothing sends during an IME composition. Suggestion pills fill the composer; while the agent works they give way to a shimmering status and send turns into stop. The card keeps its height: the thread scrolls.

anatomy.description: Fixed height; the thread takes the room the composer leaves.
The real Tabs (pill): the strip is the header, each panel holds one conversation and scrolls. Marked data-chat-composer="tabs" on its root

The real Message, marked data-chat-composer="message": the user's prompt as its bubble at the end (role user); an agent step as role assistant with the step's label as its name, the source as its Chip and the duration ("for 4s") as its time. A message that arrives after mount carries data-enter (set and cleared by the shared helper) while it rises in.
One row of suggestion Buttons; scrolls sideways. Hidden while busy.
The real Button (outline, sm), marked data-chat-composer="suggestion"
role=status; a Shimmer label in the suggestions row place while busy
The input box; pressing its padding focuses the textarea
Grows with its content up to 96px, then scrolls
The real Button (primary sm square) with our Tooltip naming it, marked data-chat-composer="send". aria-label Send, or Stop generating while busy; disabled while the draft is empty

items.label: string
items.messages: Array<{ role: 'user', text } | { role: 'agent', text, label?, source?, time? }>?

tabs.description: Conversations in order. Sending appends the user's message to the selected tab's messages (tabsChange); the host appends the agent's reply. Each message renders as a Message.

tab.description: Selected conversation. Defaults to the first.

suggestions.description: Prompts offered as pills (plain strings); choosing one puts it in the composer.

busy.description: The agent is working: the status replaces the suggestions, send becomes stop, Enter does not send.

status.description: Label of the busy status (an ellipsis is added).

labels.description: The fixed strings, partial: { message (the textarea's name), send, stop (the send button's name and tooltip, idle and busy), time ('for {time}', a step's duration) }.

events.submit: ({ value, tab }) Enter or the send button; value is trimmed; the composer then clears

keyboard: Tab order: the selected tab, the panel, each suggestion, the textarea, send
Tab strip: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight move and select (wrapping), Home / End jump; panels swap instantly
Textarea: Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a newline; nothing sends during an IME composition or while busy
Suggestion: Enter / Space put it in the composer and move focus to the end of the textarea
notes: The thread is role=log, so a new message is announced once; the busy status is role=status.
Send is icon-only: aria-label Send, Stop generating while busy.
16px text on coarse pointers so iOS does not zoom the page; enterkeyhint=send.

motion: panels: swap instantly; the strip's indicator is the tabs component's (slides under the pointer, jumps under the keyboard)
message: a message that arrives after mount rises in once (fndn-fade-up, duration.enter, easing.out-strong); messages present at mount and tab swaps never animate
thread: an arriving message scrolls the thread to it smoothly (scrollTo, behavior smooth; instant under prefers-reduced-motion); at mount and when a panel is shown again it opens at the end at once
field: border colour over duration.base on focus
status / suggestions: swap instantly; the shimmer is the shimmer component's loop (static under reduced motion)
buttons: the button component's press scale and colour
